name: Zhongli Quan Crossing the Ocean
material: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk
summary: Here, Zhongli Quan is crossing the ocean. He is one of the Eight Immortals (baxian), a group of popular Daoist figures who understood the way of life and could transform into otherworldly beings.
